newsitem.title: MALAWI: GERMANY TO MAINTAIN DEVELOPMENT AID FOR MALAWI.
newsitem.headline: GERMANY TO MAINTAIN DEVELOPMENT AID FOR MALAWI.

text.p: Germany on Wednesday pledged to maintain financial support for Malawi, a poor Southern African country which has already overspent its first quarter budget by $20 million this year.

Germany's new envoy to Malawi, Jurgen Hellner, told reporters in the country's commercial city Blantyre his government had lined up DM10 million in development aid for President Bakili Muluzi's government.
"There will be no cuts in our help given to Malawi," Hellner added.

He warned however that the donor community -- which funds 60 per cent of the country's annual budget -- was watching closely to see how the Malawian government cut the budget expenditure in the second quarter.
"We have to be careful in the second quarter. A warning yes, but this does not mean a no," Hellner said.
